$1F)      ; Decrement. Looks as a sort of counter to temporary freeze graphics.
$25)      ; 4-bytes buffer to compare/operate with other segments.
$31)      ; 4-bytes buffer to compare/operate with other segments.
$35)      ; 4-bytes buffer to compare/operate with other segments.
$3D)      ; Store new read values from $2800 (input port) through NMI.
$42)      ; Store old read values from $2800 (input port) through NMI.
$58)      ; Store credits value (shown in the game under "Secondi").
$5C)      ; Store bonus value (shown in the game under "Credits").
$5F)      ; Store values to be written in video and color ram, respectively.
$66)      ; Store number of baloon to be risen.
$67)      ; Program compare the content with 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05 and 0xE1. ; If 0xE1 is found here, the machine hangs showing "I/O ERROR" (see code at $C1A2).
$98)      ; Store values from content of $2800 (input port) & 0x80, & 0x40, & 0x10.
$0801    MC6845 ; MC6845 use $0800 for register addressing and $0801 for register values (see code at $CE86).
$13FF    Video RAM  ; Initialized in subroutine starting at $CF83, filled with value stored in $5E.
$1BFF    Color RAM  ; Initialized in subroutine starting at $CF83, filled with value stored in $5F. ; (In 7mezzo is located at $CB13 using $64 and $65 to store video and color ram values.)

$2800    Input port ; Multiplexed input port (code at $CE96). ; NMI routine read from here and store new values in $3A-$3D and copy old ones to $3F-$42. ; Code accept only bits 0-1-2-3-5 as valid inputs. For DIP switches, only bits 4-6-7 are valid. ; If an invalid bit is activated, it will produce an I/O error. (code at $CD0C)
